errors.text: The requested critical threshold is not identified as 900 K.
The proposed falsification experiment stops at 800 K and therefore cannot test the actual transition occurring at approximately 900 K.
The hypothesis is internally inconsistent: it initially attributes failure to decreasing stacking-fault energy, but later states that stacking-fault energy rises with temperature.
Oxide-film breakdown, oxidative wear, twinning suppression, and an order-of-magnitude wear-rate increase are introduced without direct support from the target system or cited evidence.
